# Nader Alzghoul (نادر الزغول), also known as NJ-Burrito

> Nader Alzghoul, who also uses the handle NJ-Burrito, is a QA Automation Engineer in Amman, Jordan. He tests government e-services with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman, REST Assured, JMeter and Appium. Outside work he teaches AI and robotics to youth, volunteers, and builds five free, open-source tools: NJ-Kit, QA-Wrap, Profile-Wrap, Business-Wrap and Story-Wrap, and is building Voice-Wrap. This site is his portfolio, in English and Arabic.

- [Portfolio](https://nj-burrito.github.io/): about, quick answers, work, teaching, volunteering, experience, organisations, projects, certificates, latest LinkedIn posts
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nader-alzghoul)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito)

## Projects

- [QA-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/QA-Wrap/): browser extension that records a manual test session, links each failure to the click behind it and writes the bug report. Arabic and English. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/QA-Wrap
- [NJ-Kit](https://nj-burrito.github.io/NJ-Kit/): Claude Code plugin with one working method and 41 skills, each ending in a PASS or FAIL gate. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/NJ-Kit
- [Profile-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Profile-Wrap/): free, open-source LinkedIn post manager and scheduler. Nothing goes out until you tap Allow. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Profile-Wrap
- [Business-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Business-Wrap/): Claude Code plugin and MCP server that turns a process model or a walk through a live e-service into an Arabic and English requirements document, edited on the page that prints and exported to PDF and DOCX. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap
- [Story-Wrap, The Lost Property Office (مكتب المفقودات)](https://nj-burrito.github.io/story-wrap/): his animated Arabic series, with episode 1, the cast and where each character is from
- [Story-Wrap toolkit](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Story-Wrap): Claude Code toolkit for Arabic interactive animated story reels (script, voice, sound, compose, publish)
- [Playwright + TypeScript showcase](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/playwright-ts-showcase): 26 UI and API tests, Page Object Model, fixtures, storageState, axe-core accessibility check, GitHub Actions CI
- Voice-Wrap (in progress): voice studio that clones your own voice with consent, 50 languages and dialects, Arabic with full tashkeel
- [Shalwa Automation Project](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Shalwa-Automation-Project-SAP-): Java, Selenium WebDriver, Maven and JUnit test automation framework (Page Object Model) for SauceDemo

## Facts

- Role: QA Automation Engineer, Amman, Jordan.
- Delivered: user manuals for 61 government e-services (206 Arabic and English manuals with narrated videos), SRS documents for 41 e-services, 42 staff manuals, 150 bug reports in Jira.
- Delivered QA work for 100+ government e-services: end-to-end tests, SRS documents, Arabic and English manuals.
- Tools: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, Java, Python, SQL, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.
- Certificates: ISTQB CTFL (CT-TAE and CT-AI expected 2027), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, PSM I.
- Education: Diploma in AI and Robotics Engineering, Al-Balqa Applied University.
- Teaches: AI and robotics to youth, at schools, cultural centers and businesses.
- Volunteers: session facilitator with Generations For Peace (sport for peace); poverty alleviation with 3am3dna since 2019.
- Organisations: Zaha Cultural Center, Generations For Peace, Robotna, DigiSkills Jordan, Luminus Technical University College, Al-Balqa Applied University, 3am3dna, My Area & Charities, Correlation One, Qafza, Clever Mind.
- Languages: trilingual. Arabic (native), English (C2), Spanish (learning).
- Beyond work: plays volleyball, likes teamwork and leading a team, values communication; parrots are his spirit animal.
- Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nader-alzghoul

## Quick answers

### Who is Nader Alzghoul?
Nader Alzghoul is a QA Automation Engineer in Amman, Jordan. He has delivered QA work for 100+ government e-services. Outside work he teaches AI and robotics to youth, volunteers, and builds his own free tools.

### Where does Nader Alzghoul work?
In Amman, Jordan, as a QA Automation Engineer. He writes end-to-end tests, SRS documents and Arabic and English manuals for government portals.

### What has Nader Alzghoul built?
He builds free, open-source tools: Profile-Wrap (plans, writes and checks LinkedIn posts), NJ-Kit (a working method for Claude Code with 41 skills), QA-Wrap (a browser extension that writes bug reports from a test session) and Business-Wrap (Arabic and English requirements documents from evidence) and Story-Wrap (Arabic animated story reels made with Claude Code). He is now building Voice-Wrap, a voice studio that clones your own voice with consent.

### Which testing tools does Nader Alzghoul use?
He uses Playwright, Selenium, Cypress and Appium for UI tests, Postman and REST Assured for APIs and JMeter for load tests, with Java, Python and SQL in GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. He holds ISTQB CTFL and is preparing for ISTQB CT-TAE and CT-AI (expected 2027).

### Does Nader Alzghoul teach?
Yes. He teaches AI and robotics to youth at schools, cultural centers and businesses, and he facilitates sport-for-peace sessions with Generations For Peace.

### Which languages does Nader Alzghoul speak?
He is trilingual: Arabic is his native language, his English is at C2 level, and he is learning Spanish.

### How can I contact Nader Alzghoul?
Through LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/nader-alzghoul, or on GitHub as NJ-Burrito.
